'''Stillwater Farms''' was a farming complex located in the [[Gorinth Agricultural Sector]], a region in the southern edge of the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The farmers offered to share their supplies with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Varmett]] massacred them and took them for himself.
